input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
errors: The 4,800-point flow run hit the two-hour background-task limit at 3,026 rows and was stopped; the harness note said not to restart a task that already had the maximum timeout, so the preregistered prefix rule (run.complete) decided the analysed set (25 of 40 designs).

doc_friction.issue: The flow timing guidance ('1 to 2 hours on 4 cores ... use --resume if one stops') does not say that a cloud background task is capped at two hours; a 40-design set at ~25 points a minute needs about three, so the run plan should size the set to the cap or split it across sessions up front.
The Stop hook asks to commit untracked/modified files every turn while a long flow run is still appending to results.jsonl, which forced several checkpoint commits of a partial table.

deviations.why: Next asked for about 40 designs; the background limit allowed 25.
deviations.did: Fixed a seeded run order and a complete-prefix rule before the flow ran, then analysed the 25-design prefix.
deviations.result: All eight predictions held on the 25; the remaining 15 are left for a descriptive --resume in a later session.

writeups: research/verified-dse/PAPER.md (abstract, Section 3 second confirmatory set, Section 6 item 6)
notes: Local checks: tests/test_ladder_confirm2.py and test_ladder_confirm.py 8 passed; research/_homepage/build.py ok; check_designs.py 40/40. Probe ~20 min, flow ~2 h on 4 cores (OpenROAD 26Q3, Yosys 0.70 from nixpkgs cache).

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

human_equivalent.basis: design and verify 5 RTL families, preregister, run and analyse a 3,000-point flow, write up; about two working days for a PhD student

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
server-tool fees (web search is billed per search, not per token); the count is recorded, not priced
